title: Canonical JSON serialization
responsibility: Serializes JSON-shaped values with sorted object keys at every depth while preserving array order.

inputs.name: canonicalJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-shaped value to serialize. Undefined object properties are omitted; arrays retain order. Objects are read through enumerable own keys rather than a custom JSON serializer.

outputs.name: canonicalJson
outputs.description: Compact JSON text with recursively sorted object keys and unchanged array order for JSON-serializable input.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An enumerable getter that throws stops serialization, and its original error propagates unchanged.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: BigInt values have no JSON form, so JSON.stringify throws a TypeError.
